description: Commune de Saint-Morillon : Carte de l'aptitude à l'assainissement autonome is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by saint-morillon.fr. Map of the suitability for autonomous sanitation of the municipality of Saint-Morillon: an overview and two zooms on the main sectors. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Municipality of Saint-Morillon: Map of fitness for self-sustaining sanitation" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include inspire, assainissement, Communauté de Communes de Montesquieu. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
